verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair question for a media-processing tool, but the evidence documents no FFmpeg feature for defining rules that fire actions on events. FFmpeg runs only as a CLI and library invoked per job. The community report of building motion detection inside a single ffmpeg process is a user-assembled filtergraph, a developer building block rather than a rule/trigger capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
